approval.scope: User-approved promotion of verified golden sizing for LDO, poweramp and PA1088 on 2026-11-05

dut_transformations: Full-precision sizing is required: worst bandwidth is 95.086464 MHz against 95.0079 MHz minimum, and worst power gain is 22.727869 dB against 22.717189257142927 dB minimum.
The paper reports 111.774 MHz bandwidth while its reported edge difference is 110.774 MHz; the retained target uses the explicitly reported bandwidth.
Stability is checked over the retained 1 MHz to 1 GHz span with strict K>1 and |Delta|<1. The source span begins at 1 Hz; no claim is made outside the simulated span.
Psat and peak PAE are maxima over the retained input-power sweep. The paper uses the slow BJT section; all three supplied BJT model sections are tested here. Zin and Zout remain excluded.

analyses.name: dcOp
analyses.statement: dcOp dc write="spectre.dc" maxiters=150 maxsteps=10000 annotate=status

analyses.name: noise
analyses.statement: noise noise values=[433M] oprobe=PORT_OUT iprobe=PORT_IN annotate=status

analyses.name: sp
analyses.statement: sp sp ports=[PORT_IN PORT_OUT] start=1M stop=1G dec=300 donoise=no  oprobe=PORT_OUT iprobe=PORT_IN annotate=status

analyses.name: hb
analyses.statement: hb  hb  fundfreqs=[f0]  maxharms=[25]  freqdivide=1 errpreset=conservative  annotate=status

outputs.name: Psat_dBm
outputs.expression: ymax((10 * log10(((0.5 * real((value(getData("RF_OUT" ?result "hb_fd") VAR("f0")) * conjugate(value(getData("PORT_OUT:p" ?result "hb_fd") VAR("f0")))))) / 0.001))))

outputs.name: PAE_peak_percent
outputs.expression: ymax(((100 * ((0.5 * real((value(getData("RF_OUT" ?result "hb_fd") VAR("f0")) * conjugate(value(getData("PORT_OUT:p" ?result "hb_fd") VAR("f0")))))) - (0.001 * (10**(xval((10 * log10(((0.5 * real((value(getData("RF_OUT" ?result "hb_fd") VAR("f0")) * conjugate(value(getData("PORT_OUT:p" ?result "hb_fd") VAR("f0")))))) / 0.001)))) / 10))))) / ((- VAR("VCC")) * real(value(getData("VDD:p" ?result "hb_fd") 0)))))
